summary.zh: 读写编辑表格，清理并重组杂乱数据
summary.en: Read, edit and clean spreadsheet files and tabular data.

description.zh: 支持 .xlsx、.xlsm、.csv、.tsv 的读取、写入与公式计算，可修掉错行错列、合并表头之类的脏数据，也能从零建表并设置格式与图表。适合交付规范表格或修复他人表格。使用前需要安装表格处理依赖。
description.en: Reads, writes and recalculates .xlsx, .xlsm, .csv and .tsv files, cleaning messy rows, misplaced headers and junk data, and building sheets with formatting and charts from scratch. Requires spreadsheet libraries installed.
